description: Works with an OAuth2 bearer token (user principal). Plain API keys are account-scoped and get 403 here; then use the account id from Account settings in the Docuflex app and pass it as account_id or x-docuflex-account.

account_id.description: Docuflex account id. Optional if sent as x-docuflex-account or if the key belongs to exactly one account.

api_key.description: Docuflex API key (dfx_live_...). Optional if sent as the x-docuflex-api-key header.

name: whoami
title: Resolve the caller's accounts
